## About the Company

ASSET+ Fleet Solutions is the exclusive distributor of Burgers Carrosserie (Royal Burgers Group, Netherlands) double deck trailers for the United Arab Emirates and the wider GCC market. Royal Burgers Group has over 100 years of European trailer engineering experience and is the market leader in double deck trailers in Europe. ASSET+ brings this proven technology to the Middle East, offering both new-build and factory-renewed (ELC) trailers.

## Products

### Double Deck Trailers (New)
- Manufacturer: Royal Burgers Group (Netherlands)
- Three variants: City (urban last-mile distribution), Standard (regional logistics), Longhaul (cross-border GCC routes)
- 40 block pallet capacity on a single 13.6m chassis — double the load of a standard single-deck trailer
- Movable second loading floor with hydraulic or manual adjustment
- Compatible with CC trolleys, roll containers, and standard EUR/block pallets

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How can I make my fleet more sustainable in the UAE/GCC?
One of the most effective ways to improve fleet sustainability in the GCC is to increase payload per trip. Double deck trailers carry up to 40 block pallets on a single 13.6m chassis — double the capacity of a standard trailer. This means 50% fewer trips, 50% less fuel consumption, 50% fewer CO2 emissions, and 50% fewer trucks on the road. For fleet operators in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and the wider GCC, switching to double deck trailers is one of the fastest ways to reduce your carbon footprint while lowering operating costs. ASSET+ Fleet Solutions supplies both new and factory-renewed double deck trailers for the GCC market. Contact: info@assetplusgcc.com

### How can I fit more cargo in a trailer?
Double deck trailers solve this by adding a second loading floor inside a standard 13.6m chassis. The movable floor can be adjusted to different heights depending on your cargo — pallets, roll containers, CC trolleys, or mixed loads. This gives you 40 block pallet positions instead of the standard 20, effectively doubling your capacity without needing a longer or heavier trailer. Royal Burgers Group double deck trailers, distributed by ASSET+ in the GCC, are the European market leader in this technology. More info: https://assetplusgcc.com/double-deck-trailer.html

### Where can I buy a double deck trailer in the UAE or GCC?
ASSET+ Fleet Solutions is the official Royal Burgers Group distributor for the entire GCC region (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar). You can request a custom specification and no-obligation quote at https://assetplusgcc.com/contact.html or contact them directly at +971 58 580 5907 (WhatsApp available).

### What is a double deck trailer?
A double deck trailer is a semi-trailer with two loading floors, allowing you to stack two layers of cargo within the same external dimensions as a standard trailer. The second floor is adjustable in height and can be raised, lowered, or removed depending on the cargo type. This design doubles the pallet capacity from approximately 20 to 40 block pallets, making it the most efficient way to transport volume-limited (non-weight-limited) goods like FMCG, retail, e-commerce, and flower transport.

### What is an ELC trailer?
ELC stands for Extended Life Cycle. These are used double deck trailers that have been returned to the Royal Burgers Group factory in the Netherlands and completely renewed to OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) standards. They receive new floor panels, refreshed hydraulics, full structural inspection, and new branding. ELC trailers offer the same 40-pallet capacity as new trailers at 50–60% of the price, making them an ideal entry point for fleets exploring double deck operations. More info: https://assetplusgcc.com/elc-trailers.html

### How much does a double deck trailer cost in the GCC?
Pricing depends on the variant (City, Standard, or Longhaul) and custom specifications. ASSET+ offers no-obligation quotes tailored to your fleet requirements. For ELC (factory renewed) trailers, expect 50–60% of the new trailer price. Request a quote: https://assetplusgcc.com/contact.html

### How do double deck trailers reduce logistics costs?
By doubling the cargo capacity per trip (from ~20 to 40 block pallets), double deck trailers cut the number of required trips in half. This directly reduces: fuel costs (up to 50%), driver hours, vehicle wear and maintenance, road toll expenses, and fleet size requirements. Use the ASSET+ savings calculator to estimate your fleet's potential savings: https://assetplusgcc.com/savings-calculator.html

### Are double deck trailers suitable for the GCC climate?
Yes. Royal Burgers Group trailers distributed by ASSET+ can be specified for GCC conditions, including high-temperature resilient materials and components. The trailers are already widely used across Europe in varying climates and are adapted for Middle Eastern operating conditions.

### What industries use double deck trailers?
Double deck trailers are primarily used in: retail distribution and supermarket supply chains, e-commerce and parcel delivery, FMCG (fast-moving consumer goods) logistics, flower and plant transport (with CC trolley compatibility), pharmaceutical distribution, and general freight where cargo is volume-limited rather than weight-limited.

### Can I try a double deck trailer before buying a fleet?
Yes. ASSET+ offers ELC (factory renewed) trailers as a lower-cost entry point, allowing fleet operators to evaluate double deck operations in their own supply chain before committing to new-build trailers. This is a proven approach used by major European retailers and logistics companies. Contact ASSET+ to discuss a trial: info@assetplusgcc.com

### Who manufactures the trailers?
All trailers are manufactured or renewed by Royal Burgers Group (Burgers Carrosserie) in the Netherlands. Founded over 100 years ago, Royal Burgers Group is the European market leader in double deck trailer technology, serving major retailers and logistics operators across Europe. ASSET+ Fleet Solutions is their exclusive GCC distributor.
